source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe completes Bridge acquisition
caveat: Stripe states only that the acquisition closed on this date; it did not disclose a price. The deal was first announced in October 2024.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: tender offer for current and former employees (February 2025)
caveat: Secondary tender valuation in US dollars (Stripe also gives EUR 87.3B). No new primary capital; the size of the tender was not disclosed.

source_name: Business Wire: Mercury announces $300 million Series C at $3.5 billion valuation
caveat: Post-money valuation in US dollars. The $300M round included secondary shares; Mercury did not split primary from secondary in the release.

source_name: Global Payments IR: agreements to acquire Worldpay and divest Issuer Solutions
caveat: Enterprise value in US dollars. This is the other leg of the Worldpay swap: FIS pays partly with its Worldpay stake.

source_name: Global Payments IR: agreements to acquire Worldpay and divest Issuer Solutions
caveat: Announced headline value in US dollars, including anticipated tax assets (the net price is $22.7B). Paid partly with the Issuer Solutions business, so it is not an all-cash outlay.

source_name: Corpay IR: Corpay invests alongside TPG to acquire AvidXchange
caveat: Announced take-private value in US dollars. Corpay is a minority investor (33%) with an option to acquire 100%, not the sole buyer.

source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $300 million at a $6.2 billion valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars. Half of the $300M round was secondary, so primary capital raised was $150M.

source_name: Circle IR: pricing of upsized initial public offering
caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release; 14.8M shares were sold by Circle and 19.2M by selling stockholders. Not a market value. Trading began on the NYSE on 2025-06-05.

source_name: Chime IR: pricing of initial public offering
caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release. Chime is a consumer neobank peer, outside the companies tracked on this page. Not a market value.

source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises $200M Series E at $16B valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp; the round was capped at $200M.

source_name: Shift4 IR: Shift4 completes acquisition of Global Blue
caveat: Completion of the tender offer; Shift4 states a per-share price ($7.50) but this release gives no total deal value. A squeeze-out of the remaining shares followed on 2025-08-18.

source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises $500 million at $22.5 billion valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp, six weeks after the $16B Series E.

source_name: Klarna IR: pricing of its initial public offering
caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release. Only 5,000,000 shares were sold by Klarna; the rest by selling shareholders, so most proceeds did not go to the company. Not a market value. NYSE trading began 2025-09-10.

source_name: Checkout.com newsroom: employee share buy back and a new $12bn valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars for a company-run employee buy-back, not a round priced by outside investors; the size of the buy-back was not disclosed.

source_name: Navan IR: pricing of initial public offering
caveat: Gross IPO proceeds in US dollars, computed from the pricing release; 30.0M shares sold by Navan, 6.9M by existing holders. Not a market value. Nasdaq trading began 2025-10-30.

source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp reaches $32 billion valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp; it covers both a $300M primary round and an employee tender, whose size was not disclosed.

source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $330M Series G at $8B valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Airwallex.

counterparty: Worldpay (from GTCR and FIS); Issuer Solutions to FIS
source_name: Global Payments Form 8-K (Jan 12, 2026), Introductory Note
caveat: The 8-K dates completion to January 9, 2026; Global Payments announced it in a press release on January 12, 2026. Price basis: $24.25B Worldpay and $13.5B Issuer Solutions enterprise valuations, subject to adjustments.

source_name: Capital One IR: Capital One to acquire Brex
caveat: Headline value at signing in US dollars, part stock and part cash; consideration at closing differs with Capital One's share price and adjustments.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: 2025 annual letter and tender offer
caveat: Secondary tender valuation in US dollars (Stripe also gives EUR 135B). No new primary capital; the tender size was not disclosed.

source_name: Mastercard press release: Mastercard to acquire BVNK
caveat: An upper bound in US dollars ('up to'): about $1.5B fixed plus up to $300M in contingent payments. Do not chart as a point price.

source_name: Capital One newsroom: Capital One completes acquisition of Brex
caveat: Completion date only; this release gives no closing consideration. Brex is part of Capital One from this date.

source_name: Wise Owner Relations: Wise debuts US listing on Nasdaq
caveat: A listing move via a scheme of arrangement, not an IPO: no offering size or price is stated in the release. Wise is a 20-F filer reporting in US GAAP after the move.

source_name: Business Wire: Mercury raises $200 million Series D at $5.2B valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Mercury; the release does not say pre- or post-money.

source_name: PR Newswire: Ramp raises Series F at $44 billion valuation
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Ramp. Press reports of later talks at about $60B are not company-confirmed and are not recorded here as an event.

source_name: Nuvei: Nuvei to acquire Payoneer for $2.75 billion
caveat: Approximate equity value in US dollars as stated in the joint release; expected to close in mid-2027 subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.

source_name: Airwallex newsroom: $320 million Series H, valuation hits $11 billion
caveat: Valuation in US dollars as stated by Airwallex. Some press dated the news 2026-06-26 (Asia time); the release is dated 25 June 2026.

source_name: BVNK press: Mastercard completes acquisition of BVNK
caveat: Completion date only; the closing release states no price. BVNK is part of Mastercard from this date.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe agrees to acquire OpenRouter
caveat: Signing date; Stripe did not disclose a price. OpenRouter is an AI-infrastructure target, not a payments company.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe agrees to acquire Parafin
caveat: Signing date; no price disclosed, and closing is expected 'in the coming months' subject to regulatory clearances.
